style: Coherent line control icons plus the user-supplied full-color pearl rocket brand asset
status: Selected proposals for user review; not yet implemented in the app
policy: Preserve supplied SVG geometry. Monochrome controls receive only a root fill in black, white or currentColor; the separately supplied pearl rocket stays full color with root sizing/framing changes only. No replacement drawings.
source_licensing: No README, LICENSE or other non-SVG file was present in the archive. Preserve provenance and confirm the applicable original icon license before publishing the integrated application.
coverage: Application-owned controls from the reviewed header/dashboard/footer, deployment dialogs, editor tools and AI panel. Preserve native VS Code file-type/language/product icons unless separately requested.
notes: Selections are deliberately coherent line icons rather than a mix of line and fill variants.
Some icons serve several actions with the same meaning. The aliases are explicit in the manifest; tooltips and accessible names still identify the individual actions.
The old standalone main-menu More button is removed by the requested dashboard consolidation. The ellipsis here is only for responsive editor action overflow.
No dedicated PHP logo, git-fork or debugger step glyphs were found; closest supplied icons are marked.
